title: Can I SURVIVE Atomic Chess?
summary: The creator plays chess.com Atomic chess against higher-rated humans (~1800-1900), aiming for three wins. Every capture causes an explosion in the 3x3 area around the capture square, destroying the capturing piece, the captured piece and all adjacent non-pawn pieces; pawns in the blast are immune. Exploding the enemy king wins. He aims knights at f7, notes that castling next to his knight would be an instant win, wins games 1-3 and a bonus game 4 (losing nothing), noting check must be prioritised.
rules: Any capture causes an explosion: the capturing piece, the captured piece and every non-pawn piece on the 8 surrounding squares are removed.
Pawns are immune to explosions in the surrounding squares (but a pawn that captures or is captured is removed).
Exploding the opponent's king (directly or in the blast radius) wins immediately; a king may not capture.
You may not make a capture that would explode your own king.
Kings may stand adjacent (adjacent kings cannot be checked) - standard atomic rule (inferred).
win_condition: Explode the enemy king (or checkmate). Goal: 3 wins vs higher-rated humans.
